Explore Watch
Shop Watch
More from Watch
Fitness
Better by every measure.
Run circles around your Activity rings. Move. Exercise. Stand. T
To know you is to move you.

Create a Custom Workout. Tailor your workout and training style on your Apple Watch or iPhone by modifying time, distance, or calorie goals. You can also receive alerts for pace, heart rate, cadence, and power. <picture class="overview-fitness-fitness-custom-workouts positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/fitness/fitness_custom_workouts__oguy124n47um_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/fitness/fitness_custom_worko

Your workout data on your iPhone. The fitness data from Series 11 appears in the Fitness app on iPhone. Track your progress, view completed workouts, change your goals, and share your activity with others. <picture class="overview-fitness-fitness-summary positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/fitness/fitness_summary__ci3oti7zl4ya_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/fitness/fitness_summary__ci3oti7zl4ya_small_2x.jp

Get a load of training load. Know when to push or when to recover thanks to helpful insights that make it easier for you to see the impact your workouts have on your body over time. <picture class="overview-fitness-fitness-training-load positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/fitness/fitness_training_load__drwwb5vdc7ue_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/fitness/fitness_training_load__drwwb5vdc7ue_small_2x.jpg 2x"

Health
Know your body by heart.
Get notified of chronic high blood pressure.
More features to empower your health.

Wake up to your sleep score. Sleep quality is influenced by factors such as sleep duration, bedtime consistency, how often you wake up, and time spent in each sleep stage. Sleep score analyzes these factors every night and provides a classification and a score. You’ll see how the score is calculated, so you can understand the quality of your sleep and learn how to make it more restorative. <picture class="overview-health-health-sleep-score positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source src

Get retrospective ovulation estimates. Series 11 has advanced sensors that track your wrist temperature while you sleep. The Cycle Tracking app uses this data to provide a retrospective estimate of when you likely ovulated, which can be helpful for family planning. <picture class="overview-health-health-ovulation positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/health/health_ovulation__uc4iv571raam_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-series-11/c/image
On the go
A 5G leap in connectivity.

It’s all in the wrist flick. Mute incoming calls, silence timers, dismiss notifications, and more — just by quickly turning your wrist over and back. It’s singlehandedly more convenient when your hands are full. <picture class="overview-on-the-go-wrist-flick-alt-endframe fallback-frame positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/on-the-go/wrist_flick_alt_endframe__c255dvwur9ci_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/on-the

Smart Stack hints. Genius. With improved prediction algorithms that fuse on-device data and trends from your daily routine, the Smart Stack delivers a gentle prompt when it has a suggestion that’s immediately useful for you. Oh look, it’s time for a jog. <picture class="overview-on-the-go-go-training-load positioned-media-element pin-offset static"> <source srcset="/v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/overview/on-the-go/go_training_load__dduga9yhjtea_small.jpg, /v/apple-watch-series-11/c/images/ove
